import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long invert_mod(long a, long m) {
        if (m == 1) return 0;
        a %= m;
        if (a < 0) a += m;
        if (a == 0) throw new ArithmeticException("a should not be zero");
        if (a == 1) return 1;
        return m - invert_mod(m, a) * m / a;
    }

    static class ModularNumberType {
        private int val;
        public static final int MOD = 1000000007;

        public ModularNumberType() {
            this.val = 0;
        }

        public ModularNumberType(long v) {
            this.val = (int)(v % MOD);
            if (this.val < 0) this.val += MOD;
        }

        public int getValue() {
            return val;
        }

        public static boolean equals(ModularNumberType a, ModularNumberType b) {
            return a.val == b.val;
        }

        public static boolean notEquals(ModularNumberType a, ModularNumberType b) {
            return a.val != b.val;
        }

        public ModularNumberType bitwiseComplement() {
            ModularNumberType res = new ModularNumberType();
            res.val = invert_mod(val, MOD);
            return res;
        }

        public ModularNumberType plusEquals(ModularNumberType o) {
            this.val += o.val;
            if (this.val >= MOD) this.val -= MOD;
            return this;
        }

        public ModularNumberType minusEquals(ModularNumberType o) {
            this.val -= o.val;
            if (this.val < 0) this.val += MOD;
            return this;
        }

        public ModularNumberType timesEquals(ModularNumberType o) {
            this.val = (int)((long)this.val * o.val % MOD);
            return this;
        }

        public ModularNumberType divideEquals(ModularNumberType o) {
            return this.timesEquals(o.bitwiseComplement());
        }

        public static ModularNumberType plus(ModularNumberType a, ModularNumberType b) {
            ModularNumberType res = new ModularNumberType(a.val);
            res.plusEquals(b);
            return res;
        }

        public static ModularNumberType minus(ModularNumberType a, ModularNumberType b) {
            ModularNumberType res = new ModularNumberType(a.val);
            res.minusEquals(b);
            return res;
        }

        public static ModularNumberType times(ModularNumberType a, ModularNumberType b) {
            ModularNumberType res = new ModularNumberType(a.val);
            res.timesEquals(b);
            return res;
        }

        public static ModularNumberType divide(ModularNumberType a, ModularNumberType b) {
            ModularNumberType res = new ModularNumberType(a.val);
            res.divideEquals(b);
            return res;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;

        final int n = 6;
        ModularNumberType[][] p = new ModularNumberType[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                p[i][j] = new ModularNumberType(0);
            }
        }

        int _n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < _n; j++) {
                int a = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                p[i][j] = new ModularNumberType(a).divide(new ModularNumberType(100));
            }
        }

        final int f = 20;
        ModularNumberType[][] sets = new ModularNumberType[2][1 << f];
        for (int t = 0; t < 2; t++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << f); j++) {
                sets[t][j] = new ModularNumberType(0);
            }
        }

        List<Integer>[] masks = new List[2];
        masks[0] = new ArrayList<>();
        masks[1] = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < j; k++) {
                    int maskVal = (1 << i) ^ (1 << j) ^ (1 << k);
                    masks[0].add(maskVal);
                    masks[1].add(((1 << n) - 1) ^ maskVal);
                }
            }
        }

        if (f != masks[0].size()) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Mismatch in mask size");
        }

        for (int t = 0; t < 2; t++) {
            for (int e = 0; e < (1 << (n / 2 * n)); e++) {
                ModularNumberType prob = new ModularNumberType(1);
                int[] edges = new int[n / 2];
                for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
                    edges[i] = 0;
                }
                for (int i = 0; i < n / 2 * n; i++) {
                    boolean r = ((e >> i) & 1) == 1;
                    ModularNumberType pp = p[(i / n) * 2 + t][i % n];
                    if (r) {
                        prob = prob.times(pp);
                    } else {
                        ModularNumberType oneMinusPP = new ModularNumberType(1).minus(pp);
                        prob = prob.times(oneMinusPP);
                    }
                    edges[i / n] |= (r ? 1 : 0) << (i % n);
                }
                int work_mask = 0;
                for (int a = 0; a < masks[t].size(); a++) {
                    int mask = masks[t].get(a);
                    int[] rArr = new int[n / 2];
                    for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
                        rArr[i] = edges[i] & mask;
                    }
                    if (rArr[0] != 0 && rArr[1] != 0 && rArr[2] != 0) {
                        int totalBits = 0;
                        for (int val : rArr) {
                            totalBits += Integer.bitCount(val);
                        }
                        if (totalBits == 3) {
                            int x = Integer.bitCount(rArr[0] | rArr[1]);
                            int y = Integer.bitCount(rArr[0] | rArr[2]);
                            int z = Integer.bitCount(rArr[1] | rArr[2]);
                            if (x >= 2 && y >= 2 && z >= 2) {
                                work_mask |= (1 << a);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                sets[t][work_mask] = sets[t][work_mask].plus(prob);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < f; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << f); j++) {
                if (((j >> i) & 1) == 1) continue;
                sets[0][j ^ (1 << i)] = sets[0][j ^ (1 << i)].plus(sets[0][j]);
            }
        }

        ModularNumberType answer_alt = new ModularNumberType(0);
        for (int j = 0; j < (1 << f); j++) {
            ModularNumberType term = sets[0][j].times(sets[1][((1 << f) - 1) ^ j]);
            answer_alt = answer_alt.plus(term);
        }
        answer_alt = new ModularNumberType(1).minus(answer_alt);
        System.out.println(answer_alt.getValue());
    }
}
